name: 02790 · Westport, MA
findings: ZIP 02790 (Westport) has 46 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02790 (Westport) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 02790 (Westport) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 74% of the typical level).
